description:
A bare expression statement WITH AN EFFECT at a body-top is evaluated, not rendered (ruled S441 item 3): the page shows only the declared

. (Since ruling S445 item 2 the statement must have an effect — the former bare `@count` here is now E-STMT-NO-EFFECT, see body-top/no-effect-statement-rejected.)
rationale: §40.8 S441 bullet (ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S441 "prose should be declared as such" + "declared-prose implementation: yes to all four"): a `<program>` / `<page>` / `<channel>` body is a code-default body — a bare run there is code, checked exactly as inside `${ … }`, never page text; S445 item 2: an expression statement with no effect is an error, a call is an effect.
